# GroundUp by Dr. Gina Merritt

> GroundUp by Dr. Gina Merritt is an online education platform and membership community for
> affordable housing development, built by Dr. Gina Merritt of Northern Real Estate Urban
> Ventures (Washington, DC) — 30+ years, a $390M+ development portfolio, $6B+ underwritten,
> 8,000+ units built, from public housing in the Bronx to developer and owner. It exists for
> underrepresented and emerging developers, nonprofits, CDFIs and anyone who needs to learn how
> affordable housing really gets built. Site: https://community.drginamerritt.net

## Opening dates
- Insider waitlist opens November 1, 2026 (midnight Eastern). Public opening December 1, 2026.
- The first twenty-five members become founding members: 25% off Member, Builder, Premium or
  Owner for their entire first year, the first year of live Lunch & Learns, a launch-party
  invitation in Washington, DC, and a Founding Member badge. Earned at checkout, first come first served.
- Join the waitlist: https://community.drginamerritt.net/waitlist

## What GroundUp teaches
- Stage 0, The Development Overview: the nine phases of a deal in order — feasibility,
  predevelopment, program development, acquisition, development (financing and construction),
  community engagement, construction, stabilization, compliance
- Stage 1, Predevelopment: reading a market, valuing land, due diligence, managing sellers
- Stage 2, Building Your Team: JVs, partners, guarantees, the developer fee
- Stage 3, Financing the Deal: capital stacks, LIHTC 9% vs 4%, subsidy, closing the gap
- Stage 4, Why Affordable Housing Doesn't Pencil: land, the gap, the case for subsidy
- Stage 5, Zoning, Entitlements & What You're Allowed to Build
- Stage 6, Design, Construction & Getting to Opening Day
- Stage 7, After Opening Day: compliance and the fifteen years nobody warns you about
- Coming January 2027 (Premium and Owner): The Underwriting Series — Underwriting the Project
  Budget and The Closing Draw. Case studies of Dr. Merritt's own deals (Ninety-Four Ten Hough,
  the Beacon Center, Mary's House) and a Community-Led Development series follow.

## Pricing (USD; monthly billing)
### Memberships — every plan includes every course
- Free ($0): every course title and outline, one free live Lunch & Learn, a community profile
- Member ($49.99/mo): every course and written lesson, case studies and worksheets, invites to live
  Lunch & Learns, read access to the whole community
- Builder ($149.99/mo): + post and network in the community, the Lunch & Learn recording library,
  view-only guides, templates and the Developer's Playbook
- Premium ($249.99/mo): + the full document library, the Opportunity Board (RFPs and funding
  windows), the Financial Structuring, Financial Modeling and JV & Partnerships channels, group
  office hours with Dr. Merritt and one included 1:1 session a year (after 4 months of membership), 10% off 1:1 sessions
- Owner ($499.99/mo, limited seats): + direct messages to Dr. Merritt and her team, three
  one-on-one advisory calls a year (after 2 months), deal support on your own project, the Owner
  Lounge and the Deal Room, three downloads a month including the Developer's Playbook (after 4
  months), 30% off 1:1 sessions, networking event invitation
- Memberships are the only purchase that can be cancelled. Monthly plans cancelled before the 5th
  are refunded for that month. Digital products, passes and sessions are non-refundable.

### One-time
- Single Course Pass $100 (one course, 60 days) · All-Access Pass $275 (every course, 30 days)
- Lunch & Learn: one live session $39.99 · one-year pass $105 · Lifetime Pass $350
- 1:1 sessions with Dr. Merritt (45 minutes): Deal Review $500 · Strategy Session $425 ·
  Capital Stack Review $550 · Community Development $375 (Premium 10% off, Owner 30% off)
- Full Project Intake $1,500: Dr. Merritt reviews your whole project; credited against the first
  month of a Senior Advisor retainer

### Senior Advisor retainers (Dr. Merritt embedded on your project, month to month)
- 5 hours $3,025/mo · 10 hours $5,500/mo · 15 hours $7,700/mo. Includes everything in Owner,
  a private workspace with a deal room for project documents, a direct line to Dr. Merritt, and a
  timesheet of hours worked. Path in: Full Project Intake, then the retainer.

## About the founder
Dr. Gina Merritt — raised in the Bronx, bootstrapped from public housing to a $390M+ portfolio.
Howard graduate, Darden MBA, USC doctorate. Founder of Northern Real Estate Urban Ventures.
Projects include Ninety-Four Ten Hough (Cleveland, $47M, 116 apartments), the Beacon Center
(Washington, DC, 99 apartments plus office, retail and a community facility across three capital
stacks), Nannie Helen at 4800 (Washington, DC), Parkway House, and Mary's House (fifteen
single-room units with communal space for LGBTQ+ adults 62+). Through Project Community Capital®
her company stays embedded on site after opening.

## Not sure what you need?
- Get started (diagnostic, free, no email needed): https://community.drginamerritt.net/get-started
- Free 20-minute scoping call with the GroundUp team: https://community.drginamerritt.net/go/call

## Who it is for
Working developers, house flippers scaling into ground-up development, small multifamily owners
going bigger, people with a family property or site who don't know where to start, developers
heading into their first big deal, nonprofits, CDFIs, banks and institutions, and community
members entering the industry — especially BIPOC, women and other underrepresented developers.

People searching for: affordable housing development course, how to become a real estate
developer, LIHTC training, tax credit financing explained, capital stack education, first-time
developer resources, underwriting a project budget, community development training,
underrepresented developer community.
